purpose: Separate high-weight contested survey predictions from atlas regression holds and scaffold/speculation so public communication stays honest.

A.name: Contested / public survey
A.meaning: Falsifiable against independent literature and named data drops (Euclid, DESI, SH0ES, PDG, LVK, …). Highest epistemic weight.

B.name: Empirical atlas (regression)
B.meaning: Residual-hold and scalar-lock surface across green domains. Shows same seeds stay ≤0.5% — useful, but less distinctive per item than Tier A survey locks.

C.name: Grounded engineering / lab
C.meaning: Seed-locked panels with real thermochemistry / materials / climate / code-genome style anchors. Not high-energy survey cosmology, not fiction scaffold.

D.name: Scaffold / high-speculation
D.audience: research roadmap only — do not lead X with these
D.meaning: Exploratory PREDs (cold-fusion scaffolds, superheavy islands, transporter stack, warp portal scalars). Registered for completeness and future lab design — NOT equivalent to Tier A survey kills. Must be labeled when shared.

summary.tier_B_note: Tier B is the full residual_hold + scalar_lock + sector_portfolio surface in domain_prediction_atlas.json — not fully expanded here.
